meta.title: A zero-quantity award does not add the vendor's full quote to the total
gaps: The available award_vendor fields do not expose a quantity parameter, so the plan cannot encode awarding the whole line to vendor 1 and zero units to vendor 2.
The available read_proposal read-back fields do not expose vendor award quantities or totals, so the assertion that vendor 2 contributes ₹0 cannot be checked.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (is_partial_awarding_enabled) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where two QA vendors bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for a second QA vendor.
As the buyer, read the award proposal and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
